info.title: Account Manager (OEM/Auto)
info.jobDescription:
Sanhua Automotive is looking for an Account Manager to join our team in our Auburn Hills office.

The ideal candidate comes with 2-3 years of experience in account management and sales for an automotive component supplier. They posses a strong understanding of the fundamentals of the automotive industry sales process experience is a critical factor in this role. 

Responsibilities:

The Account Manager is responsible for: 

  • Relationship and Account Management: Manage the overall relationship with customers, cultivating key stakeholder relationships across sales and application engineering functions to ensure successful account management and support for all projects from RFQ to EOP.
  • Contract and Pricing Negotiation: Negotiate long-term contracts, new production pricing, warranty terms, and prototype prices to secure new business and achieve yearly sales targets. Provide input for Automotive Forecast Preparation and obsolescence claims negotiations.
  • Project and Quotation Management: Oversee project management for assigned customers, drive internal cost analysis for new project quotations, anticipate customer RFQ and RFI activities, and quote Engineering Change Requests (ECR).
  • Customer Support and Site Visits: Attend regular site visits to customers, coordinate with engineering on assigned tasks, and ensure customer demand fulfillment in collaboration with the logistics team.
  • Leadership and Strategy Implementation: Implement business sales strategies established by the Key Account Manager. With the account without a Key Account Manager, take the lead in driving sales efforts, facilitating commercial discussions and negotiations, and lead sales efforts to gain internal acceptance of customer strategies.
  • Market Trend Monitoring and Reporting: Follow market trends, keep management informed on important issues concerning assigned accounts, and coordinate with the Program Manager to ensure program milestones and production capacity are on track.
  • Sales and Accounts Receivable Control: Review weekly sales and AR amounts, follow up with customers to maintain company sales and AR targets, and provide input for the preparation of obsolescence claims.
  • Major KPIs: Sales Plan setup and execution, On top of Account Receivable and Inventory control, New business pursuing.

Requirements: 

Skills:
  • Negotiation and Persuasion: Essential for closing deals and maintaining profitable relationships.
  • Communication: Key for client interactions, presentations, and internal coordination.
  • Analytical and Strategic Planning: Important for market analysis, forecasting, and developing sales strategies
  • Leadership and Team Management: Useful if the role involves leading a sales team or coordinating with other departments
  • Bachelor’s degree in business, marketing, engineering or a related field is required, along with significant experience in sales, particularly in the automotive industry.
  • Networking: Strong networking skills to build and maintain relationships with key stakeholders in the automotive industry. Ability to communicate effectively and engage with people at different levels within customer and corporate organizations.
  • Willingness to Travel a minimum of 20%

info.title: Customer Service Representative
info.jobDescription:
Position Summary

Sanhua is looking for a Customer Service Representative (CSR) to support customer service, order processing, logistics coordination, inventory management, and sales operations. This role will work closely with customers and internal teams to ensure orders are processed accurately, shipments are coordinated efficiently, and business information is maintained within company systems.

Essential Responsibilities

  • Manage customer orders from receipt through delivery.
  • Analyze and coordinate inverter shipping plans from the SHI warehouse.
  • Provide support for warehouse, logistics, and financial processes through the SHI platform.
  • Support sales operations by maintaining inventory records and monitoring product availability.
  • Assist with invoicing and accounts receivable activities.
  • Process product returns and related documentation.
  • Maintain and update Business Partner, Material, and Pricing data within the SAP system.
  • Work with internal teams to resolve order, inventory, shipping, and customer service issues.
  • Support business account transition activities, including data imports, risk control measures, and implementation plans.
  • Prepare reports and maintain accurate records as required.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

Qualifications

Education

  • Associate's degree or Bachelor's degree preferred.
  • Equivalent combination of education and experience will be considered.

Experience

  • 2+ years of customer service, sales support, logistics, supply chain, or related experience preferred.
  • Experience with order processing, inventory management, or logistics coordination is a plus.
  • Experience working with SAP or other ERP systems preferred.

Skills & Knowledge

  • Strong customer service and communication skills.
  • Good organizational and time management abilities.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office, including Excel.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines.
  • Attention to detail and accuracy in data entry and record keeping.
  • Ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams.
  • Experience with SAP is a plus.

Physical & Work Requirements

  • Office-based position located in Houston, TX.
  • Ability to sit for extended periods and work on a computer.
  • Occasional interaction with warehouse operations may be required.

info.title: Logistics Operations Intern
info.jobDescription:
Position Summary

Sanhua International is seeking a motivated and detail-oriented Logistics Operations Intern to support daily warehouse and supply chain operations. This internship provides hands-on experience across key logistics functions, including receiving, shipping, inventory control, auditing, warehouse management systems (WMS), and operational documentation. The successful candidate will gain valuable exposure to distribution center operations while developing skills applicable to future careers in logistics, supply chain management, and operations.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

Receiving Operations

  • Assist with scheduling inbound shipments and container arrivals.
  • Verify packing lists against receiving documentation and physical inventory.
  • Inspect incoming shipments for accuracy and report discrepancies.
  • Ensure received materials are processed accurately within the Warehouse Management System (WMS).

Shipping Operations

  • Review and verify customer orders prior to shipment.
  • Assist with Bill of Lading (BOL) preparation and shipping documentation.
  • Generate and apply shipping labels.
  • Coordinate with carriers for pickups and deliveries.
  • Support truck loading activities while ensuring shipping accuracy.
  • Maintain shipping records and upload required documentation.

Inventory Control

  • Participate in cycle counts and physical inventory activities.
  • Assist with inventory discrepancy investigations and root cause analysis.
  • Maintain accurate inventory records within the WMS.
  • Support inventory reconciliation efforts to ensure inventory accuracy.

Warehouse Systems & Administrative Support

  • Learn and utilize Warehouse Management Systems (WMS) to support daily operations.
  • Process logistics and inventory-related documentation.
  • Maintain organized records and operational reports.
  • Communicate with internal teams to resolve operational issues and support customer needs.
  • Assist with continuous improvement initiatives within warehouse operations.

Qualifications

Education

  • Currently pursuing or recently completed a Bachelor's degree in Logistics, Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, Operations Management, or a related field preferred.

Skills & Competencies

  • Strong attention to detail and organizational skills.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
  • Ability to work effectively in cross-functional and multicultural teams.
  • Willingness to learn warehouse, logistics, and supply chain operations.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Previous internship, warehouse, logistics, or supply chain experience is a plus.
  • Familiarity with inventory control processes, ERP systems, or WMS platforms is preferred but not required.

What You'll Gain

  • Hands-on experience in logistics and supply chain operations.
  • Exposure to receiving, shipping, inventory control, and warehouse management processes.
  • Experience using Warehouse Management Systems (WMS).
  • Professional development through mentorship and on-the-job training.
  • Opportunities to build skills for future careers in supply chain, logistics, and operations management.

Sanhua International is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment is contingent upon successful completion of a background check and drug screening.

info.title: Mechanical Engineer
info.jobDescription:
Sanhua's Automotive Business Unit is looking for a Mechanical Engineer to join our team in our Auburn Hills, Michigan office. This person will be the primary technical interface to OEM and tier customers on thermal management-related products and programs. Specifically, automotive thermal expansion valves, thermal bypass valves, receiver dryer, check valves, etc. In addition to providing technical support as needed. 

The ideal candidate will have a Mechanical Engineering Degree a solid understanding MS office application, GD&T, mechanical drafting, DVP&R, DFMEA, and DRBFM methodologies. This person is patient, has excellent time-management skills, and practices of effective communication style.

Responsibilities: 

  • Responsible for managing thermal management system/component programs and supporting customers in North America.
  • Support program team in product development activities including internal design reviews and gate reviews, weekly PDT meetings with customers, design/process validation planning, PPAP preparation, and documentation, etc. 
  • Support new business acquisition through analysis of customer specifications and requirements, conceptual design, and technical proposals 
  • Support engineering change process and cost reduction initiatives, both internal and external 
  • Conduct design of experiments, failure analysis for thermal management related products, analyze validation test results, compile report and present to customers 
  • Interface with packaging, service, manufacturing, and other engineering groups in system/component development process 
  • Resolve customer complaints by investigating problems, developing solutions, preparing reports, and making recommendations to management 
  • Maintain professional and technical knowledge by attending educational workshops and/or seminars, reviewing professional publications, establishing personal networks, participating in professional societies and conferences 
  • Coordinate design and development activities of thermal management assemblies and components in China headquarter 

· Some local, domestic and international travel may be required 

Requirements:

  • BS Mechanical Engineering 
  • 0-2 years’ experience HVAC systems/components development or master’s degree in Mechanical Engineering preferred 
  • Knowledge in thermodynamics, thermal management, fluid dynamics 
  • Competency in MS office applications, GD&T, mechanical drafting, DVP&R, DFMEA, and DRBFM methodologies 
  • Parametric CAD design experience (Catia V5 or UGNX) 
  • Must be proficient in Chinese
  • Excellent oral and written communication skills. 
  • Demonstrated ability to work effectively in cross-functional teams

info.title: Product Engineer (TPM_Bilingual Mandarin and English)
info.jobDescription:
*Seeking a Technical Program Manager/Product Manager with at least 1 year background in mechanical engineering, automotive systems, thermal management, manufacturing, or product development. Experience supporting NPI, product launches, supplier coordination, and cross-functional engineering teams strongly preferred*

As a Technical Program Manager (TPM) at Sanhua’s West Coast office, the candidate will be responsible for supporting OEM and Tier 1 customers as their primary technical contact. This role involves the development of thermal management and HVAC components for EV, PHEV, and AV applications, including refrigerant valves (SOVs, EXVs, CVs), refrigerant heat exchangers (chillers, liquid-cooled condensers), electric coolant and oil pumps, and battery cold plates. The candidate will work closely with global R&D, engineering, manufacturing, and testing teams to deliver high-quality, well-engineered products.

Key Responsibilities

  • Serve as the key technical interface for OEM and Tier 1 customers, supporting Sanhua’s business and product lines.
  • Meet regularly with customer engineering and product teams to resolve technical, packaging, production, supply chain, and quality issues.
  • Analyze product requirements and lead engineering activities, concept design, compliance matrix creation, and RFQ proposal reports.
  • Understanding of thermal management systems, including refrigerant loops, coolant loops, and oil loops.
  • Knowledge of manufacturing processes, such as casting, forging, brazing, machining, and injection molding, to product development.
  • Coordinate the development of CAD models and 2D drawings, and direct simulation activities (CFD, FEA, and optimization studies) to support customer programs.
  • Support HVAC and thermal system design and development, including component integration, testing, simulation, and system engineering.
  • Track industry trends and work with the global R&D team to develop new products and improve existing ones.
  • Lead discussions with manufacturing, process engineering, service, packaging, and supply chain teams to support product development and VA/VE (Value Analysis/Value Engineering) activities.
  • Benchmark competitive thermal components and systems to quantify functional targets and develop engineering specifications.
  • Open-mindedness to new ideas and perspectives, embracing different opinions and changes while maintaining a willingness to learn from others.
  • Show strong ownership of projects, with self-motivation to take proactive action and effective communication skills to coordinate cross-functional teams.
  • Develop technical documentation for existing and new products, including design specifications, manufacturing guidelines, and product catalogs.
  • Represent Sanhua at industry conferences and symposiums, contributing to technical workshops, publications, and paper reviews.

Key Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Mechanical or Electrical Engineering, specializing in heat transfer, thermodynamics, HVAC&R, and fluid mechanics.
  • *MUST* speak Mandarin
  • 0-3 years of experience in thermal management for EV, PHEV, or AV applications, preferably within an OEM or Tier 1 supplier environment.
  • Hands-on experience with refrigerant and coolant heat exchangers, sensors, valves, and pumps.
  • Strong understanding of refrigerant-based, coolant-based, air-cooled systems, as well as injection-molded, brazed/welded/cast components and high-voltage products.
  • Working knowledge of automotive system design, packaging, and assembly requirements.
  • Excellent communication and problem-solving skills, with a demonstrated ability to work with global, cross-functional teams.
  • Experience in plant operations and vehicle/program launches is a plus.
  • Willingness to travel as required.

info.title: Production Operator
info.jobDescription:
The Production Operator is responsible for performing assembly tasks according to standardized work instructions, ensuring quality output, and maintaining a clean and safe work environment.

Responsibilities
  1. Assemble automotive components based on work guidelines and quality standards.       
  2. Perform routine cleaning and organization of the production area.            
  3. Monitor equipment for basic operational issues and report abnormalities.                         
  4. Participate in continuous improvement activities.                                                                              
  5. Adhere to safety protocols and wear required personal protective equipment.  

Qualifications
High School Diploma or Equivalent
Prior experience in manufacturing or assembly is preferred.
Operating and monitoring production machinery.
Basic manual dexterity and attention to detail
Machine Operation, Time Management, Adaptability

info.title: Quality Inspector
info.jobDescription:
The Quality Inspector is responsible for the direct inspection, measurement, and testing of products at various stages of production. This role ensures that all raw materials, in-process components, and finished goods strictly adhere to engineering drawings, specifications, and quality standards, serving as the frontline guardian of product quality.            

Responsibilities
  1. Perform first-article, in-process, and final inspections using precision measuring tools; Read and interpret complex engineering drawings and geometric dimensioning and tolerancing (GD&T). 
  2. Accurately document all inspection results and maintain clear, detailed quality records.         
  3. Identify, segregate, and tag non-conforming products, and support the Material Review Board (MRB) process.                                                                           
  4. Utilize and maintain calibrated measurement equipment, supporting Measurement System Analysis (MSA) activities.                                                                          
  5. Assist in the containment and verification of corrective actions for quality issues.               
  6. Uphold a safe and organized work environment, complying with all company and OSHA safety procedures.         
Qualifications
High school diploma or equivalent; a technical certificate or associate degree in a related field is preferred
Minimum of 2 years of experience as a Quality Inspector in a manufacturing environment; automotive experience is a significant advantage
Demonstrated proficiency in using basic and advanced metrology equipment. Experience with Coordinate Measuring Machines (CMM) is a strong plus.
Strong ability to read and interpret engineering drawings and specification.
Basic computer skills for data entry and report generation.
Meticulous attention to detail, a commitment to accuracy, and high integrity

info.title: Warehouse Associate
info.jobDescription:
The Warehouse Associate manages the storage and movement of raw materials and finished goods, ensuring inventory accuracy and warehouse organization.

Responsibilities
1.Receive, store, and issue materials using FIFO or other specified methods.             
2.Conduct cycle counts and support physical inventory audits.                                                                    
3.Update inventory records in the warehouse management system (WMS).                                            
4.Conduct Layered Process Audits (LPA) to ensure strict adherence to defined processes on the shop floor     
5.Maintain warehouse cleanliness and compliance with safety standards.   

Qualifications
Minimum 1 years’ experience in warehouse operations
Proficiency with WMS or inventory software
Knowledge of safety regulations (OSHA standards)
Ability to operate material handling equipment
Inventory Management, Time Management, Attention to Detail
